Vikram: heads up — noticed jittery p95 and a small QA EM delta after flipping aurora-13b to llm.int8 weight-only in the canary pool. coldstarts jump and a few QA slices show regressions.
Elena: can you post a tiny log sample and the quant flags you passed? want to rule out tokenization or prompt preprocessing differences.
Vikram: pasted redacted log:
```
[2026-03-15T14:01:02Z] req=abc123 model=aurora-13b quant=llm.int8 seq=512 batch=1 coldstart=true
gpu_ms=138 tail_ms=18 tokens=64 kv_cache_misses=3 fallback_fp16=false
qa_em_drop=1.7%
```
Sara: 1.7% EM on QA slice is actionable. same model artifact and tokenizer?
Vikram: same artifact hash + tokenizer checksum. only change was runtime flag `--quantize=llm.int8` using bitsandbytes backend.
Michael: we've seen small deltas before on weight-only paths — often due to head-level rounding or different decode ordering. sequence-length distribution can expose different kernels.
Elena: also possible KV-cache cold path: int8 decode may avoid optimized fastpath during KV rebuild, adding latency and subtly changing token timing. that can affect beam/pruning in some decoders.
Vikram: instrumented runtime. coldstart time spikes inside `kv_merge` and `decode_step` for int8. kv_miss correlates with tail latency.
ops-bot: deploy 2187654321 -> canary(aurora-13b,llm.int8) completed :white_check_mark: 1% traffic
Sara: propose 3 quick experiments: (1) micro-eval slices at seq lengths [64,256,1024] comparing llm.int8 vs fp16; (2) warmup first N tokens in fp16 then switch to int8; (3) group-size sweep (64/128/256) for bitsandbytes. collect per-slice EM + p50/p95 + kv_miss.
Vikram: running (1) now. script: `python eval_slices.py --model aurora-13b --quant {fp16,llm.int8} --slices qa,math,longform --seq 64,256,1024 --out /tmp/quant.json`
Elena: for (2) runtime quick patch: `--warmup-mode=fp16:tokens=64` — warms KV cache with a short fp16 run. cheap to A/B.
Michael: if warmup fixes both latency and EM, that indicates a scheduling/ordering sensitivity rather than pure quantization arithmetic bug.
Sara: add metrics: `first_token_time`, `kv_miss_rate`, `first_10_token_logit_entropy`. these are great signals for early divergence.
Vikram: overnight run summary (int8 vs fp16):
- seq=64: p50 +14ms, EM -1.2%
- seq=256: p50 +36ms, EM -1.9%
- seq=1024: p50 +9ms, EM -0.4%
weird, medium seq worst.
Elena: medium seqs often hit intermediate kernel that neither fully amortizes int8 overhead nor uses large-block KV optimizations.
Michael: can you capture attention-head norms for failing examples? quant might push some heads toward saturation.
Vikram: collecting head norms + token entropy. int8 shows higher variance in early-token entropy on failing QA prompts.
Sara: plan: roll canary to 0.5% and run warmed fp16->int8 (2). if warmup reduces EM delta, default warmup toggle for canaries for 2 weeks. run full offline GEM/QA suite (20k) and set rollback threshold if any slice drops >3% EM.
Vikram: pushed warmup patch. ops-bot shows update.
ops-bot: canary update -> warmup-mode=fp16:tokens=64 for aurora-13b :package:
Vikram: also started group-size sweep (64/128/256).
Elena: group-size can affect block quantization error distribution; try 128 vs 64.
Vikram: quick results: warmup reduced coldstart p95 by ~40ms and QA EM went 1.9% -> 0.6%. group-size=128 slightly better than 64 for that slice. uploading artifacts: https://internal.redwood/reports/2187654321/quant-warmup-sweep
Sara: good signal. next actions: (1) short RFC to expose per-model warmup toggles + thresholds, (2) add dashboard tiles for `int8_warmup_success_rate` and `kv_miss_rate`, (3) schedule small AWQ/GPTQ micro-bakeoff on the failing slice to compare quality vs perf.
Michael: if warmup + group tuning don't fully close gap, we should evaluate AWQ or GPTQ on the slice; might accept slightly higher cost for quality-sensitive workloads.
Vikram: leaving canary at 0.5% until EOD tomorrow, will post final per-slice diffs.
Sara: set automated rollback: if any QA slice EM drop >3% over baseline across 1k samples, revert quant change automatically.
ops-bot: note: canary traffic auto-scaled down to 0.5% at 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z due to quota rules :information_source: 
Vikram: thanks all — will close with final numbers after the full offline run. keep threads short here, will open a ticket with artifacts if we need product/ops involvement.
